correctness.rationale: The first two updates give x^(2)=alpha[(2+beta)I-alpha A]b, so for a Stieltjes matrix positivity for every b>=0 is equivalent to alpha a_ii<=2+beta. Uniformly over spectra [mu,L] this is alpha L<=2+beta, and substitution of Polyak's optimal parameters is exactly kappa<=9. For diagonal modes the normalized error satisfies the stated Chebyshev-U recurrence; q<=1/2 bounds every error above by 1, while at the L endpoint q>1/2 gives e_2=q^2(3+2q)>1. Independent exact arithmetic reproduced the kappa=16 negative second coordinate; the infinite all-mode statement is analytic.
